<?php

class MessageQueueConsumer {
    private $queueConnection;
    private $serviceRegistry;
    private $httpClient;
    
    const HEADER_TERMINATOR = "\r\n\r\n";
    const MAX_HEADER_SIZE = 8192;
    const TRUSTED_SERVICES = ['auth-service', 'payment-service', 'inventory-service'];
    
    public function __construct($queueHost, $queuePort) {
        $this->queueConnection = new AMQPConnection($queueHost, $queuePort);
        $this->serviceRegistry = new ServiceRegistry();
        $this->httpClient = new InternalHttpClient();
    }
    
    public function consume(string $queueName): void {
        $channel = $this->queueConnection->channel();
        $channel->basic_consume($queueName, '', false, false, false, false, 
            [$this, 'processMessage']);
        
        while ($channel->is_consuming()) {
            $channel->wait();
        }
    }
    
    public function processMessage($msg): void {
        $payload = json_decode($msg->body, true);
        if (!$payload || !isset($payload['target_service']) || !isset($payload['action'])) {
            $msg->nack();
            return;
        }
        
        $targetService = $payload['target_service'];
        if (!in_array($targetService, self::TRUSTED_SERVICES, true)) {
            $msg->nack();
            return;
        }
        
        $authToken = $this->generateServiceToken($targetService);
        $response = $this->forwardToService($targetService, $payload, $authToken);
        
        if ($response['status'] === 200) {
            $msg->ack();
        } else {
            $msg->nack();
        }
    }
    
    private function generateServiceToken(string $service): string {
        $timestamp = time();
        $nonce = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $secret = getenv('SERVICE_SHARED_SECRET');
        if ($secret === false || $secret === '') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('SERVICE_SHARED_SECRET is not configured; refusing to sign token with an empty key');
        }
        $payload = base64_encode(json_encode([
            'iss' => 'queue-consumer',
            'sub' => $service,
            'iat' => $timestamp,
            'nonce' => $nonce
        ]));
        $signature = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $secret);
        return $payload . '.' . $signature;
    }
    
    private function forwardToService(string $service, array $payload, string $token): array {
        $endpoint = $this->serviceRegistry->resolve($service);
        $body = json_encode($payload['data'] ?? []);
        $contentLength = strlen($body);
        
        $headers = $this->buildRequestHeaders($payload, $token, $contentLength);
        $request = $this->assembleHttpRequest($payload['action'], $endpoint, $headers, $body);
        
        return $this->httpClient->sendRaw($endpoint['host'], $endpoint['port'], $request);
    }
    
    private function buildRequestHeaders(array $payload, string $token, int $contentLength): array {
        $headers = [
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Content-Length' => (string)$contentLength,
            'X-Service-Auth' => $token,
            'X-Request-ID' => bin2hex(random_bytes(8)),
            'Connection' => 'close'
        ];
        
        if (isset($payload['headers']) && is_array($payload['headers'])) {
            $allowedCustomHeaders = ['X-Correlation-ID', 'X-Trace-ID', 'X-Priority'];
            foreach ($payload['headers'] as $name => $value) {
                $normalizedName = str_replace(' ', '-', ucwords(str_replace('-', ' ', strtolower($name))));
                if (in_array($normalizedName, $allowedCustomHeaders, true)) {
                    $headers[$normalizedName] = $this->sanitizeHeaderValue($value);
                }
            }
        }
        
        return $headers;
    }
    
    private function sanitizeHeaderValue(string $value): string {
        $value = str_replace(["\r", "\n"], '', $value);
        if (strlen($value) > 256) {
            $value = substr($value, 0, 256);
        }
        return $value;
    }
    
    private function assembleHttpRequest(string $action, array $endpoint, array $headers, string $body): string {
        $path = $this->resolveActionPath($action);
        $request = "POST {$path} HTTP/1.1\r\n";
        $request .= "Host: {$endpoint['host']}:{$endpoint['port']}\r\n";
        
        foreach ($headers as $name => $value) {
            $request .= "{$name}: {$value}\r\n";
        }
        
        $request .= "\r\n";
        $request .= $body;
        
        return $request;
    }
    
    private function resolveActionPath(string $action): string {
        $actionMap = [
            'validate' => '/api/v1/validate',
            'process' => '/api/v1/process',
            'notify' => '/api/v1/notify',
            'sync' => '/api/v1/sync'
        ];
        
        if (!array_key_exists($action, $actionMap)) {
            return '/api/v1/default';
        }
        return $actionMap[$action];
    }
}

class InternalHttpClient {
    public function sendRaw(string $host, int $port, string $rawRequest): array {
        $socket = $this->getConnection($host, $port);
        fwrite($socket, $rawRequest);
        
        $response = '';
        while (!feof($socket)) {
            $response .= fread($socket, 4096);
        }
        fclose($socket);
        
        return $this->parseResponse($response);
    }
    
    private function getConnection(string $host, int $port) {
        $socket = fsockopen($host, $port, $errno, $errstr, 5);
        if (!$socket) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Connection failed: {$errstr}");
        }
        stream_set_timeout($socket, 30);
        return $socket;
    }
    
    private function parseResponse(string $raw): array {
        $parts = explode("\r\n\r\n", $raw, 2);
        $statusLine = explode(' ', $parts[0], 3);
        return [
            'status' => (int)($statusLine[1] ?? 500),
            'body' => $parts[1] ?? ''
        ];
    }
}

class ServiceRegistry {
    public function resolve(string $service): array {
        $registry = [
            'auth-service' => ['host' => '10.0.1.10', 'port' => 8080],
            'payment-service' => ['host' => '10.0.1.20', 'port' => 8080],
            'inventory-service' => ['host' => '10.0.1.30', 'port' => 8080]
        ];
        return $registry[$service] ?? ['host' => '127.0.0.1', 'port' => 8080];
    }
}
